PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.

2. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

9. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands
